name: 140.3 — bind is the one link
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 140.3: w:bind(opt) joins a control to an option both ways and typed — the control takes the value, a write to the option moves it silently, the user's move writes the option; bind() reads, bind(nil) unbinds, a second bind replaces, a mismatch and a borrowed control are refused.
